reply_text: @Sofia Marchetti, it was **Pellow Home Living**, not Pellucid. In #coastal-team on Feb 17, you confirmed that the retail account showing the lamp delivery at door 6 was yours, and that Pellow handles the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, which is where the container pickups were. Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail in February.
